verdict.rationale: Terraform is an infrastructure-as-code CLI and platform, not an AI agent or LLM host, so acting as an MCP client that consumes other servers' tools does not fit its product type. The evidence only documents Terraform's own MCP server, which serves Terraform docs, modules, policies and workspace operations to AI models. That is the opposite, server-side role and earns no credit here. Nothing in the pack shows Terraform connecting to or loading external MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
